decisions.reason: A mitred lever handle family is a durable catalogue item for a premium architectural hardware maker like FSB, and it remained on the website in 2024, so withdrawal within a year is unlikely.
Its promotion to a dedicated page in 2024 signals growing strategic importance, making removal very unlikely.
Door handle models typically stay in long-lived catalogues for many years, and it was still listed in 2024, so dropping it soon is improbable.
The FSB 1289 collection has its own page and has won the German Design Award and the iF Design Award, making it a flagship the firm will keep.
